native_payload.intent: Remove pkg/scheduler's direct dependency on k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core/validation (toward moving the scheduler to staging) by replacing validation.NoteLengthLimit with a local noteLengthLimit = 1024 used by truncateMessage, and drop the matching allow rule from pkg/scheduler/.import-restrictions. Behavior is meant to stay the same.
residual_risks: The local noteLengthLimit (pkg/scheduler/schedule_one.go:61) is a copy of NoteLengthLimit (pkg/apis/core/validation/events.go:37) and the values match (1024). The copy is safe only while the API server never lowers that limit. A lower limit would break already-released clients too, and the comment on the constant records this assumption. If the limit is raised, the only effect is extra truncation of FailedScheduling event messages. (correctness, adversarial)
